tokens.kjv: (well-) beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

tokens.bdb: I
tokens.kjv: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

tokens.bdb: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] break, companion, keep company with, devour, eat up, evil entreat, feed, use as a friend, make friendship with, herdman, keep (sheep) (-er), pastor, [phrase] shearing house, shepherd, wander, waste.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.enLiteralWord: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanation: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively
tokens.explanationEn: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively

tokens.bdb: a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
tokens.kjv: lily, Shoshannim.

verses.ptLiteralVerse: O meu amado é meu, e eu sou dele; ele apascenta o seu rebanho entre os lírios.

verses.hebrewText: עַ֤ד שֶׁ/יָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם וְ/נָ֖סוּ הַ/צְּלָלִ֑ים סֹב֩ דְּמֵה לְ/ךָ֨ דוֹדִ֜/י לִ/צְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְ/עֹ֥פֶר הָ/אַיָּלִ֖ים עַל הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.

tokens.bdb: to puff, i.e. blow with the breath or air; hence, to fan (as a breeze), to utter, to kindle (a fire), to scoff
tokens.kjv: blow (upon), break, puff, bring into a snare, speak, utter.

tokens.bdb: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
tokens.kjv: age, [phrase] always, [phrase] chronicals, continually(-ance), daily, ((birth-), each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), [phrase] elder, [idiom] end, [phrase] evening, [phrase] (for) ever(-lasting, -more), [idiom] full, life, as (so) long as (... live), (even) now, [phrase] old, [phrase] outlived, [phrase] perpetually, presently, [phrase] remaineth, [idiom] required, season, [idiom] since, space, then, (process of) time, [phrase] as at other times, [phrase] in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), [idiom] whole ([phrase] age), (full) year(-ly), [phrase] younger.
tokens.explanation: yom — dia, período de luz, era, tempo específico

tokens.bdb: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

tokens.bdb: shade
tokens.kjv: shadow.

tokens.bdb: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
tokens.kjv: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

tokens.bdb: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
tokens.kjv: compare, devise, (be) like(-n), mean, think, use similitudes.

tokens.bdb: (figuratively) to love; by implication, a love-token, lover, friend; specifically an uncle
tokens.kjv: (well-) beloved, father's brother, love, uncle.

tokens.bdb: splendor (as conspicuous); also a gazelle (as beautiful)
tokens.kjv: beautiful(-ty), glorious (-ry), goodly, pleasant, roe(-buck).

tokens.bdb: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
tokens.kjv: also, and, either, if, at the least, [idiom] nor, or, otherwise, then, whether.

tokens.bdb: a fawn (from the dusty color)
tokens.kjv: young roe (hart).

tokens.bdb: a stag or male deer
tokens.kjv: hart.

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
tokens.kjv: hill (country), mount(-ain), [idiom] promotion.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.enLiteralWord: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanation: a mountain or range of hills
tokens.explanationEn: a mountain or range of hills

tokens.bdb: Bether, a (craggy) place in Palestine
tokens.kjv: Bether.

verses.ptLiteralVerse: Antes que refresque o dia, e fujam as sombras, volta, amado meu, e faze-te semelhante ao gamo ou ao filho dos veados sobre os montes de Beter.
